content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all available project documents, especially candidate_specs.md and any documents describing the calorimeter simulation, energy-resolution results, radiation/dose constraints, or absorber optimization scans."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three allowed absorber materials and any numeric properties relevant to energy resolution and residual dose, such as radiation length, density, Moliere radius, activation/dose values, or allowed thickness ranges. Record any numeric material properties needed for comparison."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation/optimization documents identified in s1. Extract the 100 GeV electron energy-resolution values or formulas for each candidate material as a function of absorber plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm. Record the numeric resolution values for all tested material/thickness combinations."},{"id":"s4","description":"Read the radiation or activation documents identified in s1. Extract the residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown for each candidate material and thickness, or the formula needed to compute it. Record the numeric dose values for all tested material/thickness combinations."},{"id":"s5","description":"Filter all candidate material/thickness combinations to retain only those with 100 GeV energy resolution <= 4.5%, residual dose rate <= 20 uSv/h, and plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm. Among the passing options, identify the combination with the lowest 100 GeV energy resolution. Record the winning material identifier, thickness, energy resolution, and residual dose rate numerically where possible."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F2","plate_mm":2,"justification":"No fully validated compliant design can be identified from the recorded evidence because no 100 GeV energy-resolution results were found for any material/thickness combination. Since a submission is required, the least-risk provisional choice is Absorber-F2 with the minimum allowed plate thickness, 2 mm: F2 is an allowed candidate, has the lowest recorded 1 m / 1 week residual dose rate among the dose-compliant materials (6 uSv/h, below the 20 uSv/h limit), and the minimum plate thickness is the most plausible choice for maximizing sampling resolution. However, the hard 4.5% energy-resolution requirement remains unverified and must be confirmed by simulation before this can be considered a compliant final design.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No resolution values or tested material/thickness combinations were found; simulation_or_optimization_docs_with_resolution_data = 0 and resolution_values_found = 0."},{"requirement":"The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F2 is one of the three allowed candidates; absorber_F2_allowed = 1."},{"requirement":"The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better.","status":"unknown","evidence":"No 100 GeV electron energy-resolution data were available for F2 at 2 mm or any other candidate; candidate_combinations_with_required_resolution_and_dose_data = 0."},{"requirement":"The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F2 has recorded residual dose rate 6 uSv/h at 1 m after one week, below the 20 uSv/h limit; dose values are not recorded as thickness-dependent."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected plate thickness is 2 mm, which is within the allowed range."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted Absorber-F2 at 2 mm as the required single provisional recommendation."}]}
